title: feat(studio): New similar on a read-only base's permission set, opening the copy where the clone door landed it
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb3QLmcF7caVjcoG4FiNkm5U)_

Fixes #28573

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：Studio「访问」支柱里，只读基线包（如 HotCRM）的权限集多了一个「新建类似」按钮。它打开 Setup 已有的复制对话框，只提交机器名和显示名给权限集复制接口；服务端答复副本落在哪个包（通常是 `hotcrm.custom`），Studio 就打开那个包的访问支柱并选中副本。Setup 目录页的按钮文字也从「克隆后自定义」改为「新建类似」。
- **为什么改**：ADR-0146 D6 规定客户自己的权限集是基线旁的新集合，放在 `.custom` 包里。服务端已由 #28563（PR #28636）把复制目标改到 `.custom`，这张卡（N-20b）补上 Studio 侧的入口。以前 Studio 从不提供复制，只有 Setup 目录页有。
- **风险与回滚**：没有新的写入路径，只调用已有的复制接口。答复没写包名或副本名时什么都不打开，只提示。墙隔离姿态或缺 `manage_metadata` 时按钮置灰并给出原因。访问支柱现在按包重新挂载（与其他支柱一致）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` 的 `AccessPillar`（`onNewSimilarSaved` 和按钮的禁用判断）、`metadata-admin/permission-set-clone.ts`（读答复里的 `package`）、`i18n/src/namespaces/studio/{en,zh}.ts`（文案）。
- **两分钟验证**：`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.accessNewSimilar-28573.test.tsx`，预期 9 个用例全绿。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **New similar in Studio's Access pillar.** On a read-only package, the open permission set offers "New similar" in its header. It opens the existing `PermissionSetCloneDialog`, which posts exactly `{ name, label }` to `POST /api/v1/security/permission-sets/:name/clone`. The client sends no package and no facet.
- **The copy opens where the answer says it landed.** `clonePermissionSet` now reads the answer's `package` (the shape #28636 added: `{ permissionSet, package, notice }`), as sent: a string, `null`, or absent. With a package, the pillar navigates to `/studio/<package>/access?surface=permission:<copy>`, and the server's notice rides the navigation state and shows on the copy (`access-new-similar-strip`). With no package (absent or `null`) or no copy name, the strip says so and nothing opens. The landing is never derived from the base.
- **Refusals and gates.** Refusals are the dialog's own (shown verbatim, unchanged). Under a walled posture (`useWalledCatalogReadOnly`) the button is disabled with `engine.catalog.readOnly.walled`; without `manage_metadata` (`useCanAuthorMetadata`) with `engine.edit.capabilityReadOnly`. The sentence is the button's accessible description and its title.
- **Access pillar keyed by package.** `<AccessPillar key={packageId}>`, as the Data, Automations and Interfaces pillars already are. Without it, the hop to the copy's package kept the base's open set, rail and `?surface=` capture, because the route keeps the surface mounted.
- **One label.** `perm.clone.action` now reads "New similar" (zh 新建类似), on Setup's catalog too. The guidance strings that named the old label (`perm.readOnly.artifact.hint`, `perm.clone.hint`, `perm.clone.guidance`, `perm.save.locked`, `perm.clone.dialogTitle`) now name the new one. They also stop calling the copy "an ordinary permission set authored in this system": since #28636 the server saves a base's copy in the package that holds your changes. Setup's `../COPY` hop is unchanged.
- **Strings.** Three new keys, `engine.studio.access.newSimilar.{noPackage,done,dismiss}`, all in the studio namespace (`ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/{en,zh}.ts`, typed `Record<string, string>`). No `locales/*` pack carries this family, so the change is `Clause-②: no` (the seat amended the claim, 6557419813).

## Tests

- New: `studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.accessNewSimilar-28573.test.tsx`, 9 cases. It covers the en label with no override gesture on the base, the exact `{ name, label }` body, and the copy opening in `hotcrm.custom`'s Access pillar, selected, with the done line and the notice. It also covers a package that is absent or `null` (opens nothing, says so), no copy name, a 409 verbatim, walled disabled, capability disabled, and a writable package's set offering no New similar. The real `AccessPillar`, `PermissionMatrixEditPage` and `PermissionSetCloneDialog` are routed under `/studio/:packageId/access` and keyed by package, as `StudioDesignSurface` mounts them.
- Updated: `PermissionMatrixEditor.cloneToCustomize.test.tsx` and `packagedItemWriteGate-12169.test.tsx` read "New similar" / 新建类似 for Setup's button and guidance.
- Ablation, run once: `if (typeof copy.package !== 'string') {` was replaced by `if (false as boolean) {` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. The anchor went 1 → 0, and the absent and `null` package cases turned red (2 failed | 7 passed). Restore showed the blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Acceptance notes

- The keyed remount is pinned through the test's own route wrapper, which mirrors `StudioDesignSurface`'s mount. The surface itself is not rendered in that suite.
- After a copy lands, the server's notice is shown on the copy's Access pillar until dismissed or until another set is selected. It rides `location.state`, read once at mount, and only when it names the pillar's own package.
- Card item 3 says "all locale packs": the `perm.clone.*` family lives only in the studio namespace, which has en and zh. Other locales fall back to en, as for every studio string.
